name: cascade_heat_pump_geothermal_dh
title: Cascade (LT/HT) heat pump, geothermal water to district heating
summary: Two-loop cascade heat pump between geothermal water (60 to 40 degC, 100 kg/s) and district heating (60 to 90 degC, mass flow a result); four sectioned exchangers with an imposed 5 K pinch close the saturation pressures. Main file: R1233zd(E) with series IHX; variant: ammonia with desuperheaters.

verification.summary: Both TESPy notebooks (0.11.3) were re-run headless in a throw-away venv (work/venv, MPLBACKEND=Agg) and their full-precision results compared with the CoolSolve .sol of both files: 28 and 30 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, maximum relative deviation 3.2e-06 (variant 2, T_2_HT) and 3.0e-06 (variant 4, Q_dh). Pinch checks PPTD_MIN_* = 5 K and the overall energy balance close.
verification.reference: Re-run of the source notebooks variant_2_series_IHX.ipynb and variant_4_ammonia_desuperheater.ipynb (TESPy 0.11.3, CoolProp backend)
